subject: Telemetry add-on bundle: retention, tracing, dashboards — pricing breakpoints and proposal
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finwize.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com
Cc: mdoyle@finwize.com, procurement@finwize.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify pricing for telemetry add-ons (retention + tracing + dashboards)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profiles look great. We're close to finalizing sizing but need clarity on the add-ons. Specifically: retention beyond 90 days, distributed tracing (sampled spans per million requests), and advanced dashboard seats. Procurement also asked about volume discounts / breakpoints and whether you can cap spend for our pilot.

Can you share: 1) a simple pricing table for retention buckets (30/90/180/365+ days), 2) how tracing is billed and whether sampling adjustments change cost, and 3) what dashboard seats include and per-seat price.

We have a small pilot (approx. 100k requests/day) that could scale to 1–3M/day in 12 months. Any flexibility on retention-based discounts for committed volume would help move the contract forward.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Platform Engineering
FinWize

---
Note: procurement@finwize.com is looped for contract/PO questions.
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finwize.com>, mdoyle@finwize.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify pricing for telemetry add-ons (retention + tracing + dashboards)

Hi Elena / Mark — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful.

Quick answer up front: yes — we support flexible retention tiers and tracing billing that maps to sampled spans; we can offer step discounts tied to committed retention TB and monthly commit bands for pilots transitioning to production.

I'll attach a short proposal and a pricing sheet with breakpoints. High-level bullets:
- Retention: configurable buckets (30 / 90 / 180 / 365 / 730 days). Price per GB-month declines as you move up buckets; we can offer an additional 10% discount at >12TB/month committed.
- Tracing: billed per million sampled spans; you can adjust sampling on the fly (lower sampling reduces cost). We offer a 15% discount on tracing if tracing is purchased as part of the telemetry bundle.
- Dashboards: advanced dashboards are priced per seat with tiered seat discounts at 5 / 10 / 25 seats. Dashboards include custom widgets, alerting rules, and one curated runbook.

Would you be open to a 30-minute call this week to go over numbers and I can bring Aditya for commercial terms? I can follow up with a formal PDF proposal after that.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: (proposal stub)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com, grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: FinWize — pricing approach and proposed breakpoints (need commercial signoff)

Team — forwarding Elena's ask. Pilot numbers look modest but potential to scale. Draft commercial play below; please comment by EOD so I can send a customer-facing proposal tomorrow.

Proposal (draft):
- Telemetry bundle (recommended): includes 90-day retention by default, tracing (up to 10M sampled spans/month), and 5 advanced dashboard seats. Base bundle price: $3,500 / month for pilot (covers estimated 100k req/day).
- Retention breakpoints (price per GB-month):
  * 30 days: $0.40
  * 90 days: $0.30
  * 180 days: $0.22
  * 365 days: $0.18
  * 730 days: $0.14
- Committed-volume discounts: 5% at >=2TB/mo, 10% at >=8TB/mo, 15% at >=12TB/mo (applied to retention and tracing when part of the bundle).
- Tracing: $12 per million sampled spans; bundled discount 15% if purchased with retention.
- Dashboard seats: $150 / seat / month; discounts: 5 seats = 5% off, 10 seats = 12% off, 25 seats = 25% off.

Notes/questions for commercial:
- Aditya — can we offer a one-time pilot cap of $8k for the first 3 months to satisfy procurement? (customer asked for spend cap.)
- Grace — please confirm we can deliver 730-day retention in their region (us-east) and any additional infra fee.
- Stephanie — any objections on the 15% bundle discount for tracing?

Thanks —
Lauren

Hi Elena / Mark / Procurement team,

Thanks for the details on expected scale — attached is a concise proposal and pricing sheet for the telemetry add-ons you asked about. Highlights below:

Summary (pilot / production paths):
- Pilot bundle (recommended): 90-day retention, tracing up to 10M sampled spans / month, 5 advanced dashboard seats — $3,500 / month. Pilot protection: spend capped at $8,000 total for first 3 months.
- Retention pricing (per GB-month): 30d $0.40 | 90d $0.30 | 180d $0.22 | 365d $0.18 | 730d $0.14 (5% infra surcharge for cold-storage on 730d).
- Committed-volume discounts: 5% @ >=2TB/mo, 10% @ >=8TB/mo, 15% @ >=12TB/mo (applies to retention + tracing when purchased as a bundle).
- Tracing: $12 / million sampled spans; bundled price after 15% discount $10.20 / million.
- Dashboard seats: $150 / seat / month (5/10/25 seat discounts applied as previously shared).

Next steps:
1) Confirm pilot acceptance and whether you want 90d or 180d retention for the pilot. 90d is fine for validation; 180d gives more context for behavioral analysis.
2) If you accept the pilot terms, we'll generate a short SOW + DocuSign with the $8k cap for the first 3 months and standard conversion terms after month 3.

Attachments: FinWize-Telemetry-Proposal-v1.pdf (pricing and SOW stub), telemetry-pricing-sheet.xlsx (breakpoint calculator).

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the numbers — available tomorrow morning PST.

Thanks,
